settings.title: Materials & Construction
settings.content: 400gsm heavyweight cotton blend. Garment-washed for lived-in softness from day one. Reinforced double-needle stitching at every stress point. Pre-shrunk for consistent sizing wash after wash.

settings.title: Sizing & Fit
settings.content: Shoulder-forward construction with structured chest and tapered body. True-to-size. If you're between sizes, go up for a relaxed silhouette.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: All orders ship within 24 hours. Free returns within 30 days — no questions asked. Exchanges are always free. We stand behind every piece.

settings.title: Care Instructions
settings.content: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not bleach. Iron low if needed. The weight holds its shape — treat it right and it lasts years.
